RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias will likely be perceived as bad faith and can severely damage your professional reputation. Leadership roles like Head of Structural Engineering heavily weigh commercial acumen, business development, and client management, where the selected candidate was noted to excel despite having fewer years of technical design experience. 

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of unlawful discrimination, just as an all-male panel is not. Instead, politely follow up on your written feedback request, focusing entirely on objective criteria and professional development. If constructive feedback or subsequent disclosures reveal procedural irregularities, consult an employment attorney.
